user.title: Battery SoC
user.description: Track a battery's state of charge by counting its current, re-anchored at full and empty.

data_description.current_entity: Signed current, positive while charging (e.g. the inverter's battery charge current).
data_description.voltage_entity: Used for power/energy and for the empty/full voltage rules.
data_description.full_entity: Optional binary sensor that turns on when the battery is full, e.g. the inverter's float-charging flag. Its turning on sets 100 %; while it stays on the current is ignored.
data_description.grid_entity: Optional binary sensor, on while the utility grid is present. Used to tell an inverter shutdown at empty from a telemetry dropout.
data_description.load_power_entity: Optional: power drawn by the load from the inverter output (W). While the grid is out and the current sensor stays unavailable longer than the dropout bridge, the discharge is counted from it. Also, the inverter only counts as shut down when this shows no load.
data_description.counters_entity: Optional: a text sensor with the inverter ESP's JSON battery totals. When set, the charge is counted from them instead of the current sensor, and nothing is lost while Home Assistant can't see the ESP.
data_description.boot_entity: The ESP's JSON snapshot of those totals at boot, with the power-on flag. A power-on boot after running low marks the battery empty.
data_description.nominal_capacity_ah: Rated capacity; the learned capacity starts from it.
data_description.nominal_voltage: Used for energy only while the voltage sensor has never reported.
data_description.initial_soc: Starting point until the first full/empty anchor.

abort.already_configured: This current sensor is already used by another entry.

data_description.empty_voltage: Battery counts as empty when the voltage stays at or below this while discharging.
data_description.empty_delay_s: How long the voltage must stay low.
data_description.shutdown_delay_s: With no grid and a low battery, the current sensor unavailable this long means the inverter has switched off at empty.
data_description.low_voltage_hint: Shutdown detection only applies if the last voltage was at or below this…
data_description.low_soc_hint: …or the computed state of charge was at or below this.
data_description.full_voltage: Only without a full sensor: full when the voltage is at or above this…
data_description.max_gap_s: While the current sensor is unavailable, its last value is used for at most this long.
data_description.learn_capacity: Measure the usable capacity on every full → empty discharge.
data_description.learn_efficiency: Measure Ah out / Ah in on every cycle that ends at full.
data_description.learn_current_offset: On float the battery current is ~0, so what the sensor shows then is its offset; subtract it from all readings.

set_soc.name: Set state of charge
set_soc.description: Set the state of charge by hand (not an anchor; nothing is learned).
